qualification.details: Project Research Scientist II (Non-Medical): Postgraduate degree, including an integrated postgraduate degree, in Biomedical Engineering, Biotechnology, Materials Science, Mechanical Engineering, or a closely related discipline; OR PhD in a relevant discipline. Requires Three years of relevant post-qualification research experience. Project Research Scientist I (Non-Medical): Postgraduate degree, including an integrated postgraduate degree, in Biomedical Engineering, Biotechnology, Materials Science, or a closely related discipline. Requires experience in at least two of the preferred areas. Project Technical Support III: 3-year Graduate degree in Biotechnology/Biological Sciences/Materials Science with 3 years of post-qualification experience OR Post Graduate degree in Biotechnology/Biological Sciences/Materials Science.

Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience.

Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification.
Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 12-10-2026.
Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for MAHE Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 12-10-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Manipal Academy of Higher Education (MAHE) for positions in the Department of Integrated Research, KMC, Manipal, Karnataka.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are available under MAHE Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies available across different research and technical support posts under this particular notification.

faq.question: Q3. What are the names of the posts offered in MAHE Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The available positions include Project Research Scientist-II (Non-Medical), Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical), and Project Technical Support-III under the ICMR extramural project.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply for MAHE Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for the submission of detailed curriculum vitae (CV) and applications via email is October 12, 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the mode of application for these positions?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply by sending their detailed CVs via email to the designated official email address, ensuring the job code is mentioned in the subject line.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary range provided for these positions?
faq.answer: The salary ranges from Rs. 28,000 to Rs. 67,000 plus 10% HRA, depending on the specific post and qualification requirements.

faq.question: Q7. What educational qualifications are required for Project Research Scientist-II?
faq.answer: Applicants must hold a postgraduate degree in Biomedical Engineering, Biotechnology, Materials Science, Mechanical Engineering, or a closely related discipline with 3 years of experience, or a PhD.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for applying to MAHE Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No application fee is required or mentioned in the official notification for submitting applications to these project-based positions.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection procedure for MAHE research posts?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting candidates based on their qualifications and relevant experience, followed by an interview for the shortlisted applicants.

faq.question: Q10. Where should candidates send their application emails?
faq.answer: Candidates should send their complete application documents and CV via email to [email protected] with the appropriate job code mentioned in the subject line.
